Main ICE assembly comprising Crankcase, Cylinder heads (except combustion chamber and ports machining), Crankshaft, Camshaft (excluding cam lobes), Cam drive, Cam covers, Front and rear covers, Valvegear (valves, finger followers, air spring sub-assemblies), Internal gear drives, Auxiliaries (including ICE water pump, ICE oil pump, ICE oil scavenge pump, any air/oil separator) and their mountings, fixings and connections to the ICE, Plenum, Actuators (to allow PU to function) and their mountings, fixings and connections to the ICE, ICE-mounted air valve compressors and storage bottles

Main ICE assembly comprising Combustion chamber surface and pre-chamber detail within cylinder heads, piston, connecting rod, cam lobes, intake and exhaust ports, air valve regulators, trumpets, Throttle system
PU mounted fuel system components: (e.g., High Pressure fuel hose, fuel rail)
Fuel Injector spray pattern tuning feature
Engine exhaust system (including thermal insulation, excluding fasteners and seals)

PU and spares for all Competitions in F1 World Championship plus 5000 km testing.
Minimum number of PUs per team to be (number of PUs per driver per season according to F1 Sporting Regulations) x 2 + Necessary number of units to achieve 5000 km of testing.
Additional PUs or spares required to replace units out of service due to accident damage or other cause induced by team will be outside the supply perimeter and will incur additional charges

Travel, accommodation, and reasonable expenses for support personnel

Garage IT equipment, connection to factory, servers, telemetry, radio, team clothing
Dyno testing of installation components (Y hours or km)
